resources.string: \"%1$s\" already bundles \"%2$s\"
turning both on makes them fight; keep one.
the last game log mentions these mods on %1$d lines
no obvious conflicts found
checked %1$d mods that carry code (%2$s); some conflicts only show up once the game runs.
no mods with code in this slot
declares Java but ships no code
the game skips it: Android cannot find the entry class, so the whole pack does not load.
%1$d scripts, but no main.js
with several scripts the game only runs main.js, so these never run.
missing required dependency \"%1$s\"
that dependency is not in this slot, so the game skips this mod.
dependency \"%1$s\" is turned off
this mod will not load either; turn both on, or turn both off.
dependencies form a cycle
these mods depend on each other, so the game cannot order them and skips them.
same mod as \"%1$s\", installed twice
the game uses only one copy (the one placed later); the other is effectively not installed.
on the game blacklist
the game itself refuses to load it; try another version.
needs game version %1$s or newer
this slot runs an older game build, so the game skips this pack.
minGameVersion is too low (%1$s < %2$s)
Android mods need at least %1$s; a missing value counts as 0, so the game skips it.
could not read the classes.dex inside \"%1$s\"
could not read the game log
